'''Magnetic disks''' were components used on [[Sensor beacon/Legends|sensor beacons]] such as [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech's]] [[SE-Vigilant automated sensor beacon]]. The magnetic disk was located at the base of the beacon, and was one of the two ways that the device could be secured to the ground, the other being [[anchoring rod]]s.<ref name="EGWT" />
